$comment: Frame names Kiln's app and packages have today, each with the issue that removes it (frame-neutral.test.ts). This list only shrinks: the check fails on a hit outside it, and on an entry with no hit left. A path ending in / covers its folder (only for code phase 2 deletes whole). imports: files that still import a frame's package or a path into frames/ other than through the registry (@glassworks/frames), each with the issue that removes it; shrink-only too. notFrames: words that only look like a frame's name; they need no issue, but go when the word does.
